# Conventions
<!-- Generated by /intel. Last updated: 2026-04-13 -->

## Naming
- **Files**: `snake_case.dart` — e.g., `wallet_list_provider.dart`
- **Classes**: PascalCase — e.g., `WalletListProvider`, `BridgeService`
- **Screens**: `{Feature}{Action}Screen` — e.g., `SendScreen`, `WebSendScreen`
- **Providers**: `{entity}Provider` — e.g., `walletListProvider`, `shieldedBalanceProvider`
- **Services**: `{Entity}Service extends BaseService` — e.g., `ExplorerService`, `PrivacyService`
- **Models**: PascalCase, no prefix — e.g., `Wallet`, `TokenizedBitcoin`

## File Organization
- Feature folders at `lib/features/{name}/` with `screens/`, `components/`, `providers/`, `models/`, `services/`
- Shared code in `lib/core/` (providers, services, components, theme)
- Utilities in `lib/utils/` (toast, guards, validation)
- Web-specific features prefixed: `btc_web/`, `web_shop/`

## Error Handling
- **Services**: try/catch, `print()` error, return null or rethrow
- **UI feedback**: `Toast.message()` (green), `Toast.error()` (red) via `rootScaffoldMessengerKey`
- **Pre-condition guards**: `guardWalletIsSynced(Ref ref)`, `widgetGuardWalletIsSynced(WidgetRef ref)` in `lib/utils/guards.dart` — return bool, toast on failure
- **Dialogs**: `InfoDialog.show()`, `PromptModal.show()` for confirmations and user input

## State Management
- **Old pattern**: `class FooNotifier extends StateNotifier<T>` + `final fooProvider = StateNotifierProvider<...>(...)`
- **New pattern**: `@Riverpod(keepAlive: true) class FooNotifier extends _$FooNotifier { ... }` with codegen
- Both coexist; new features should prefer `@Riverpod` codegen
- Code-gen: `fvm flutter packages pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`

## Models
- All use `@freezed` with `part '*.freezed.dart'` and `part '*.g.dart'`
- JSON keys mapped via `@JsonKey(name: "PascalCaseApiField")`
- Computed properties as getters on the `const ClassName._()` private constructor

## Dialogs & Modals
- Static `show()` factory on dialog class: `ShieldDialog.show()`, `PromptModal.show()`
- Use `rootNavigatorKey.currentContext!` for context
- `ConsumerStatefulWidget` with `_isSubmitting` state for loading buttons

## Project-Specific Rules
- All flutter/dart commands prefixed with `fvm`
- `kIsWeb` for platform branching, never `Platform.isX` alone
- Desktop API base path: `Env.apiBaseUrl` (localhost with env-specific port)
- Service path overrides: `super(apiBasePathOverride: "/privacyapi/PrivacyV1")` to replace default `/api/V1`
